issues.detail: The Hebrew ends with 'וְשָׂמ֥וּ בַדָּֽיו' meaning 'and they shall put its poles [in place]' (referring to the altar's poles/carrying bars). The Chinese renders this as '並把他的獨自放上' which is nonsensical ('put his alone on') and omits the substantive noun 'בַדָּיו' (its poles). This is a mistranslation/omission of a key item.
